negative_reviews.author: Rugile D
negative_reviews.text: If you are hoping for an actual omakase this isn't the place, ordered the 15 piece omakase and it was a platter rather than having the pieces served individually. Quality of fish was pretty poor too, tuna had really fishy smell and all the fish was somewhat warm. Place was pretty empty when we got there but it took almost 25min to get some water.  Had high expectations for this place but left extremely disappointed.

negative_reviews.author: נועה הולצמן
negative_reviews.text: We arrived at the restaurant as a group of three diners for dinner at 9:00 PM. Although we had reserved seats in advance, it took about five minutes to get us into the restaurant, during which we waited at the entrance until the hostess, who was also a waitress, would clear up. After we sat down, we ordered drinks and food together, the waiter took our order and returned a few minutes later to inform us that the drink we requested was out of stock, and then again a few minutes later to inform us that we actually had some. We ordered some rolls that were incredibly delicious, the crispiness of the seaweed was exceptional, and overall we really enjoyed the quality of the food. Unfortunately, we were mainly disappointed with the service - we were not contacted during the meal, and around 10:00 PM we wanted to order additional dishes, but the waiter informed us that the chef had already closed the kitchen a few minutes ago. It is unclear why diners do not receive an update beforehand, especially since there were other diners in the restaurant who were still eating. Regarding the cleanliness of the place, it is mediocre.

negative_reviews.author: S K
negative_reviews.text: Expensive for what it was. Asked for drinks multiple times and they never arrived. Small portions. Cost us 42 each as a couple
